product_overview: Nagorik Setu is a government citizen engagement platform that lets registered citizens report issues, participate in discussions and polls, and track responses from government staff. It also gives officers and administrators tools to manage complaints, moderate participation, and monitor platform activity.
core_goals: Register as a citizen and access the platform
Log in as a citizen, officer, or admin using role-specific credentials
Participate in public polls and community discussions
Manage user accounts and review platform analytics as an admin

features.name: Authentication and Role-Based Login
features.description: Users access the platform through a shared login page with separate flows for citizens, officers, and admins. Citizens can also register for a new account before logging in.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Select the citizen login flow -> Enter phone number and password -> Submit the login form -> See the citizen dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Select the officer login flow -> Enter officer ID, government email, and password -> Submit the login form -> See the officer dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Select the admin login flow -> Enter email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the admin dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Select the citizen login flow -> Enter incorrect credentials -> Submit the login form -> See a login error message

features.name: Citizen Registration with OTP Verification
features.description: New citizens can create an account by providing personal details, then confirm the registration with an OTP verification step before reaching the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Enter full name, phone number, National ID, date of birth, and password -> Submit the registration form -> See the OTP verification page
Navigate to /otp -> Enter the OTP code -> Submit verification -> See the citizen dashboard

features.name: Complaint Submission
features.description: Authenticated citizens can create a new complaint and view it in their complaint list.
user_flows: Navigate to /citizen/complaints/new -> Enter complaint title, category, description, and location -> Submit the complaint form -> See the complaint appear in the complaints list

features.name: Officer Complaint Management
features.description: Authenticated officers can review the complaint queue, open complaint details, update complaint status, and send replies.
user_flows: Navigate to /officer/complaints -> Review the complaint queue -> Open a complaint's details -> Update the complaint status -> Send a reply to the complaint

features.name: Poll Voting
features.description: Authenticated citizens can view active polls and cast a vote for one option in each poll.
user_flows: Navigate to /citizen/polls -> Review the active polls -> Select an option in a poll -> Submit the vote -> See the poll results update

features.name: Discussion Forum
features.description: Authenticated citizens can browse discussions, create new discussions, and interact with existing posts through likes, comments, and bookmarks.
user_flows: Navigate to /citizen/discussions -> Review the discussion list -> Create a new discussion -> See the discussion added to the feed
Navigate to /citizen/discussions -> Open a discussion -> Like the discussion -> Add a comment -> Bookmark the discussion

features.name: Citizen Profile and Notifications
features.description: Citizens can manage their profile information and review platform notifications from their account area.
user_flows: Navigate to /citizen/profile -> Review profile details -> Update account information -> Save changes -> See the updated profile
Navigate to /citizen/notifications -> Review unread notifications -> Open a notification -> See it marked as read

features.name: Citizen Leaderboard
features.description: Authenticated citizens can view the points leaderboard to see how civic participation is ranked across users.
user_flows: Navigate to /citizen/leaderboard -> Review the points rankings -> Compare badge tiers and scores

features.name: Admin User Management
features.description: Admins can review the full user list and toggle each user's active status.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/users -> Review the user list -> Open a user's row -> Toggle the user's active status -> See the status change reflected in the list

features.name: Admin Analytics Dashboard
features.description: Admins can open the analytics dashboard to review platform-wide metrics and charts.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/analytics -> Review the platform metrics -> Inspect charts and trend summaries
